assumptions: The first milestone stays close to upstream by adding one wasm bridge crate plus narrow cfg-gated seams.
The initial supported wasm-facing surface is core and app-server rather than the native TUI.
Host services replace exec, network, filesystem, secrets, and streaming; sandbox behavior is stubbed explicitly.
The exact maceip runtime version remains unresolved because WORK.md mentions both v8 and v9.

tracks.focus: planning artifacts, phase graph, validation matrix, and coordination
workspace gating, wasm bridge crate, native-regression safety, and repo docs
host loader, capability adapters, smoke tests, and automation substrate

phases.title: Validation Harness and Scope Freeze
phases.objective: Define the supported scope, classify the workspace, and install failing wasm-first checks before implementation work starts.
validation: native cargo check remains green for codex-core, codex-app-server, and codex-cli
future wasm bridge check is defined even if the crate does not exist yet
host smoke test expectation is defined and currently failing

phases.title: Workspace Gating and Bridge Skeleton
phases.objective: Add codex-rs/wasm-bridge, keep native-only crates out of the wasm graph, and expose placeholder exports for host integration.
deliverables: mock host that loads the bridge
validation: wasm bridge symbols are exported
native-only crates are excluded from the wasm target
native cargo check still passes

phases.title: Execution and Terminal Abstraction
phases.objective: Replace direct process and PTY assumptions on the wasm path with a host executor contract.
deliverables: host exec request and response contract
validation: exec contract tests cover request, chunk, exit, and cancellation
wasm path returns explicit errors when the host executor is missing
no direct PTY or process API remains in the wasm path

phases.title: Networking and Async Runtime Adaptation
phases.objective: Move HTTP, SSE, and streaming behavior onto a host transport contract and a wasm-safe async model.
deliverables: tokio usage inventory with wasm-safe replacements
validation: HTTP fixture tests pass through the transport abstraction
streaming chunk tests pass through the host bridge
compile checks fail if native-only tokio net usage leaks into the wasm target

phases.title: Filesystem, Secrets, and Sandbox Replacement
phases.objective: Replace direct filesystem and secret access with host services and make sandbox behavior explicit stubs on wasm.
validation: filesystem round-trip tests pass
secret present and absent cases pass
sandbox calls return explicit stubbed outcomes

phases.title: Public Entry Points and Host Loader Conversion
phases.objective: Turn the wasm bridge into the supported library surface and convert the host launcher away from native process spawning.
deliverables: stable init, submit, callback, and shutdown exports
validation: host smoke test completes one request and one callback round-trip
ABI tests lock export names and payload shapes
native launcher behavior remains isolated to the native path

phases.title: Product Surface Triage, Docs, and Hardening
phases.objective: Document the supported surface, add CI separation, and keep unsupported behavior explicit and sustainable through upstream syncs.
validation: CI enforces native and wasm policy separately
unsupported features fail with user-visible errors
the documented happy path matches the smoke test
